title.en: An Act to Amend Section Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Nine of the Administrative Code, Authorizing the Director of Posts to Collect storage on Postal

text.en:
Section nineteen hundred and fifty-nine of the Administrative Code is hereby amended by
adding, at the end thereof, the following paragraph:
"The Director of Posts shall fix and collect storage charges for postal packages the consignees or addresses of
which have failed to call for them at the post offices within thirty days after being notified and requested to do
so, and for this purpose he shall, with the approval of the Secretary of Commerce and Communications,
establish a schedule of charges for these cases: Provided, That the charge made for each package shall not
exceed five centavos for each day of storage."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 4, 1919.
